capabilities: Download reMarkable documents into the vault as PDFs
Render pen strokes, colors and text styles at high fidelity
Merge annotations onto the original PDF background
Download only changed documents on later syncs
disambiguation: Not a two-way sync; it only downloads documents from the reMarkable Cloud into the vault.
extras: Desktop-only plugin; unofficial and not affiliated with reMarkable AS; authentication tokens are stored outside the vault at ~/.remarkable-sync/token.json and no telemetry is collected.
problem: Notebooks and annotations made on a reMarkable Paper Pro stay in reMarkable's cloud and are not available inside an Obsidian vault.

relations.evidence: based on / inspired by rmscene by Rick Lupton, originally written in Python

summary: Plugin that downloads reMarkable Paper Pro documents from the reMarkable Cloud into a vault subfolder as rendered PDFs.
